title: Campaign broadcasts report delivery, opens and clicks back to their campaign

source.ref: Email and messaging check 2026-11-18, live broadcast test (campaign a9f3e906, Resend broadcast a7b061d3)

detail:
EMAIL-076 sends a platform campaign as one Resend broadcast. The live one-person test on 2026-11-18 was delivered, opened and clicked (unsubscribe round trip wrote the root-Space suppression in 2 s), but the bookkeeping never closes: the outreach_sends row stays 'queued' with resend_id null, and every email_events row for the broadcast has campaign_id null, because the broadcast branch never stores the broadcast id and the webhook never reads data.broadcast_id. Campaign stats (delivered, opens, clicks) therefore read zero for every broadcast campaign. Work: store the Resend broadcast id on the campaign (or on its outreach_sends rows) when sendCampaignAsBroadcast returns, and in app/api/webhooks/resend/route.ts map data.broadcast_id plus the recipient address back to the campaign and its outreach_sends row (status delivered/bounced/complained, campaign_id on email_events).

A broadcast campaign send now writes the Resend broadcast id into each recipient's outreach_sends.resend_id (status sent; no new column). The Resend webhook reads data.broadcast_id, finds that row by broadcast id plus recipient (lib/email-studio/broadcast-attribution.ts), moves it to delivered, bounced or complained (a late delivery never overwrites a bounce or complaint), and writes the campaign id on the email_events row. Covered by lib/email-studio/broadcast-attribution.test.ts, app/api/webhooks/resend/route.broadcast.test.ts and lib/email-studio/send-scale.test.ts.

verify.note: Passes once the broadcast send stores its broadcast id and the Resend webhook attributes broadcast events by broadcast_id.
